hint_ladder.title: Ano ba ibig sabihin ng ^?
hint_ladder.text: 2^5 means 2 multiplied by itself 5 times: 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2. Hindi 2 times 5.

hint_ladder.title: Paano mag-multiply nang sunod-sunod?
hint_ladder.text: Start: 2×2=4; 4×2=8; 8×2=16; 16×2=32. Kada step, parami nang parami.

hint_ladder.title: Mga karaniwang pagkakamali
hint_ladder.text: Huwag malito sa 2×5=10 o sa 5^2=25. Exponentiation ay paulit-ulit na multiplication, hindi simpleng times.

hint_ladder.title: Double-check ang sagot
hint_ladder.text: Pagkatapos ng lahat, 32. Tumingin sa choices: C ang 32. Tama!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you thought 2^5 is 2×5. Exponentiation is repeated multiplication, not just times.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you swapped base and exponent, making it 5^2=25. But it's 2^5.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you multiplied six 2's instead of five, giving 64. Count factors: five '2's.

next_time_rule: Pag may exponent, multiply base sa sarili nang ilang beses ayon sa exponent. Huwag imultiply sa exponent mismo.
deconstruct_text:
